items.title: Updates install themselves
items.text: When a new version of Drop is out, it installs on its own. A small window shows the progress, then closes, and Drop restarts on the new version. If you're downloading something, it waits until you're done.

items.title: You'll know when it's done
items.text: After an update, Drop tells you it's up to date and opens this screen with what changed. You can open it again any time from Settings > What's new.

items.title: Your choice
items.text: Prefer to update yourself? Turn off "Install updates automatically" in Settings. Drop will just let you know when there's a new version, and Check for updates looks right away.
